subject: MAP draft — Data handling & compliance (retention, logging, PHI/PII)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@medtechinc.com>, Jonas Schmidt <jonas.schmidt@medtechinc.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft — Data handling & compliance (retention, logging, PHI/PII)

Hi Sarah / Jonas —

Great to meet today — thanks for the thoughtful questions. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_MedTech_Redwood_Draft_v2.pdf) that captures the milestones we discussed. I pulled out the Data handling & compliance milestone into its own block so legal / security owners can review quickly. Summary below: 

MAP: Data handling & compliance (draft)
- Objective: Ensure MedTech's PHI/PII handling requirements are met for the pilot and production rollout.
- Target: Decision / Contract Signed by 2026-03-31
- Key milestones & tentative dates:
  1) Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — owner: MedTech / Redwood — target: 2026-03-05
  2) SOC2 + BAA review (Redwood provides SOC2 report + BAA template) — owner: Redwood / MedTech legal — target: 2026-03-12
  3) Technical deep-dive (logging, retention options, sample dataset test) — owner: Redwood SE (Lauren) — target: 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-06
  4) Final security sign-off & go/no-go for PHI in-scope — owner: MedTech security — target: 2026-03-15

Responsibilities (draft):
- Redwood: provide SOC2 Type II report, BAA template, audit logs retention options (configurable per customer), dedicated environment option (Private/Dedicated) for PHI, redaction/PII filtering recommendations, and implementation plan for logging/audit trails.
- MedTech: provide data classification spreadsheet (see attached data-classification.xlsx), list of PHI fields, regulatory constraints (state/federal retention), and procurement/legal contact to execute the BAA.

Dependencies: legal review turnaround, procurement/BAA execution, access to a representative (anonymized) dataset for test runs, and agreement on retention windows.

Please review the attached MAP draft and the data-classification sheet and let me know: (1) any changes to owners/targets, (2) whether you need us to route for a BAA/BAA-ready environment (Private deployment), and (3) good times for the technical deep-dive (I can coordinate Lauren).

Next step: If that all looks reasonable I’ll update the MAP and schedule the SE deep-dive for the week of Mar 2.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_MedTech_Redwood_Draft_v2.pdf, data-classification.xlsx
From: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@medtechinc.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Jonas Schmidt <jonas.schmidt@medtechinc.com>
Cc: procurement@medtechinc.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft — Data handling & compliance (retention, logging, PHI/PII)

Aditya —

Thanks for the write-up and the MAP. A few clarifying points from our side after internal review:

1) PHI scope & retention: Our clinical records retention policy requires up to 7 years for PHI in many workflows; for some device logs we keep 3 years. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports per-field retention windows (e.g., retain PHI fields for 7 years, analytics logs for 90 days)?

2) BAA & HIPAA: We need Redwood to sign a BAA for any in-scope PHI. Is Redwood able to sign a BAA, and can you support storage in a Private or Dedicated environment that would be documented in the BAA?

3) Audit logs: We need immutable audit trails for data access and model queries tied to user IDs and request IDs. Can you confirm what you can provide (retention, schema, access methods)?

I've cc'd procurement to get them aware of the timeline. Please also include any SOC2 / HIPAA compliance artifacts you can share (SOC2 report + summary are ok at this stage).

I pulled a few lines from your MAP below for context:

> - Technical deep-dive (logging, retention options, sample dataset test) — owner: Redwood SE (Lauren) — target: 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-06
>
> Dependencies: legal review turnaround, procurement/BAA execution, access to a representative (anonymized) dataset for test runs, and agreement on retention windows.

We can do Mar 3 or Mar 4 in the afternoon Pacific for the technical deep-dive. Also please send the SOC2 summary and any BAA template so our legal team can start early.

Thanks,
Sarah Wong
Head of IT Security | MedTech Inc.
sarah.wong@medtechinc.com | +1 (212) 555-0101
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@medtechinc.com>, Jonas Schmidt <jonas.schmidt@medtechinc.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft — Data handling & compliance (retention, logging, PHI/PII)

Sarah — thanks, this is helpful. Quick responses inline and an updated MAP excerpt below.

1) Retention per-field: Yes — Redwood supports configurable retention windows at the resource/field level via our data retention policy settings. We can map PHI fields to 7-year retention while keeping analytics logs shorter. We'll capture the retention mapping as a deliverable in the MAP (Redwood to provide template mapping).

2) BAA & Private/Dedicated: Redwood can sign a BAA. For PHI we recommend either Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or a Redwood Private deployment (VPC/Customer-managed). We will include the BAA template in the next email.

3) Audit logs: We provide structured audit logs with request_id, user_id, timestamp, action, model_version, and SHA256 of input artifact. Logs can be exported to customer-managed storage (S3/GCS) or kept in Redwood with configurable retention. I'll attach a short SOC2 summary (SOC2-audit-summary.pdf) here for legal.

Updated MAP excerpt (Data handling & compliance):
- Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — owner: MedTech / Redwood — target: 2026-03-05
- SOC2 + BAA review (Redwood provides SOC2 report + BAA template) — owner: Redwood / MedTech legal — target: 2026-03-12
- Technical deep-dive (logging, retention options, sample dataset test) — owner: Redwood SE (Lauren) — target: one of [2026-03-03, 2026-03-04]
- Security sign-off & PHI go/no-go — owner: MedTech security — target: 2026-03-15
- Decision / Contract signed — owner: MedTech / Redwood — target: 2026-03-31

Dependencies: legal review, procurement executes BAA, access to anonymized sample dataset, confirmation of environment (Dedicated / Private) for PHI.

Next steps I will action today:
- Send SOC2 summary + BAA template to Sarah and MedTech procurement (attached).
- Coordinate SE deep-dive with Lauren for Mar 3 or Mar 4 afternoon PT (Sarah, which of those two works best?).
- Update MAP in the shared Google doc and push to the HubSpot deal (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890).

Thanks — looping Lauren to pick times.

—Aditya

Attachments: SOC2-audit-summary.pdf

Hi all —

I can run the technical deep-dive and own the logging/retention milestone. Proposed attendees: Lauren (Redwood SE), Marissa (Redwood Security), Sarah (MedTech security), Jonas (MedTech engineering), plus a procurement observer if helpful.

Agenda (45–60 min):
- 10m: Introductions & goals for the deep-dive
- 15m: Logging & audit trail schema (fields we export, retention controls, export methods)
- 10m: Retention mapping (per-field retention, deletion workflows, redaction)
- 10m: Deployment options for PHI (Dedicated vs Private) + BAA implications
- 10m: Actions & owners

Reqs before the meeting: MedTech to share a short list of PHI candidate fields (can be example names/types) and an anonymized sample (or schema) so we can show mapping/redaction in the demo. If sharing data is an issue we can use a synthetic sample.

I have slots on Mar 3 from 1:00–3:30pm PT and Mar 4 from 2:00–4:00pm PT. Sarah — can you confirm which works?

I will prepare a short tech handout (export schema + examples) and circulate it beforehand. Once we confirm the meeting I’ll update the MAP to set Security sign-off to 2026-03-12 (internal target) to accelerate procurement.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
